verdict.rationale: Thoropass runs built-in background automation: monitors automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP for compliance, integrations refresh data daily or ad-hoc, evidence is collected automatically with violation alerts, and access reviews are reminded on policy timelines. These are vendor-defined monitors rather than automations a user sets up, and the MCP server is an interactive assistant, not a background agent. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous AI agent runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
